## Lqitha - multi-agent lost & found (Tunisia)
Entry: POST /webhook/lqitha from the web app.
**Agents (LLM, Groq free tier):** 1 Intake/Router - 2 Perception (vision) - 4 Verifier - 5 Procedure (RAG) - 6 Notifier - 6b Claim check
**Tools (HTTP, Lqitha API):** speech-to-text, save report, matcher (3), RAG search, claims, notifications.
Prompts are generated from prompts/prompts.yaml (single source of truth).

nodes.name: Route action
nodes.notes: message -> agents pipeline | claim_answer -> ownership check

nodes.name: Tool - Speech-to-text
nodes.notes: Groq Whisper large-v3 (free) via Lqitha API

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ (() => { const m = $json.vision ? $env.VISION_MODEL : ($json.model_env === 'FAST_MODEL' ? $env.FAST_MODEL : ($json.model_env === 'VISION_MODEL' ? $env.VISION_MODEL : $env.TEXT_MODEL)); const r = m.includes('gpt-oss') ? {reasoning_effort: 'low'} : (m.includes('qwen') ? {reasoning_effort: 'none'} : {}); return JSON.stringify(Object.assign({}, $json.groq_body, {model: m, max_tokens: 1500}, r)); })() }}
